It's Monday, 7 a.m. You wake up. But the bed is huge. And there's a tie on the door.
You look in the mirror. And your dad is looking back at you.
Oh no. Oh no, no, no.
In your room, someone screams. It's your body. With your dad inside.
So, what if you swapped lives with your dad for a week?
Okay, rules. Seven days. Then everything goes back.
You do his job. He goes to your school. And nobody can know.
How hard can a job be?
Monday. Dad's office. Your own desk. Free coffee. This is great.
Then you open his computer. Two hundred and forty emails. All urgent.
I need that report by three.
You have no idea. So you just nod. A lot.
Your coworkers talk about meetings and deadlines all day. You don't understand a single word.
So you say "sounds good" to everything. It works. Every time.
Meanwhile, your dad is in your class. Pop quiz. Fractions.
He hasn't done fractions in twenty-five years. Four out of ten.
This is harder than my job!
At lunch, Dad sits with your friends. He tries to talk about taxes.
Nobody sits with him after that.
They said I talk like a dad. I am a dad!
Tuesday. The bills come in. Rent. The car. Food. The lights. The phone.
You add it all up. And almost all of Dad's money is already gone.
Wait. Where did all the money go?
Wednesday. Mom sends you to the store with a list. At the checkout, the number keeps going up.
Can I put one pizza back? Maybe two?
You come home with two pizzas. And no milk.
Where is the milk? I asked for milk.
And Dad? He has a science test. So he studies all night. For the first time in twenty-five years.
I got an eight! An eight!
And here's the real part. The US government added up what it costs to raise one kid, until age seventeen.
About two hundred thirty-three thousand dollars. For one kid.
Maybe I should stop asking for new sneakers.
Friday night. You both sit in the kitchen. Too tired to sleep.
I forgot how hard school is.
And I didn't know how hard your job is.
Why are you two acting so weird?
For the first time, you really get each other.
Monday, 7 a.m. The week is over. You close your eyes. You count to three.
You open your eyes. You look down. And you're still in Dad's body.
Then the doorbell rings. It's Dad's boss.
And if anyone finds out, the swap stays forever.
